claims.quote: Endemic to the states of Kerala and Karnataka in southern India.

regions.name: Valapatanam
regions.quote: Its modern distribution is highly fragmented with small populations remaining in the Valapatanam, Chaliyar, Kallar, Karyangod, Kuttiyadi, Chandragiri, Sullya, Kuppam, Iritti, Anjarakandipuzha, Bhavani, and Bharatapuzha river systems.
